description:
Do not use the Administrator user for daily work. Keep it for setting up and for repairs. Make a separate user for each leader or staff member.

The tour asks for the email address and name, and then for a role profile. The role profile sets what the user may do:
- Church Manager: everything, including settings. Best for church leaders.
- Church Staff: reads people, groups and events, and changes only the records they add.
- Church Office: day-to-day work with people, groups and events.
- Church Treasurer: giving, expenses and funds.
- Church Care Team: care, counseling and visits.
- Church Check-In Volunteer: the check-in station only.
- Church Follow-up Team: only the follow-up cards given to them.
- Church User: for members. It gives no access to the desk.

A user with no role profile cannot open the desk. A System Manager can create users.
name: Church Manager
title: Church Manager
